user.title: Feed entries
user.description: An RSS or Atom feed to follow. Its newest entries become a sensor's attribute for a dashboard card.

data_description.url: The address of the feed itself, not of the site it belongs to.
data_description.name: Names the feed's device and sensor. Leave it empty to use the feed's own title.

error.cannot_connect: The address couldn't be read. Check it and try again.
error.not_a_feed: The address answered, but not with an RSS or Atom feed.

abort.already_configured: This feed has already been added.

data_description.items: How many of the feed's newest entries the sensor holds.
data_description.interval: How often the feed is fetched, in minutes.
